overall_summary: Analysis of the performance data reveals clear outliers in husband-wife relationship themes (videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए'), generating significantly higher views (1,700+) compared to general heartbreak poetry, family tropes, or life reality shorts.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on married life dynamics ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' with 1766 views and wife emotional videos with 1674 views) heavily outperform generic heartbreak or family love shorts.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on marital intimacy, communication gaps, and everyday relationship friction.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा 💔' received very low engagement (14 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract, overly dramatic, or poetic venting; ground the emotions in mundane, recognizable real-life moments.

next_video.hook_style: Direct question about a silent habit in marriage
next_video.concept: A short exploration of how couples stop fighting and start staying silent in the same room, realizing indifference is scarier than anger.
next_video.opening_direction: Start with a close observation of a couple sitting in absolute silence scrolling phones late at night.
next_video.twist_direction: Reveal that the silence isn't peace—it's the exact moment two people stopped caring enough to argue.
next_video.reason: Matches the proven high-performing husband-wife relationship niche while leveraging late-night relatability (रात के ख्याल).

experiment: Testing if shifting the husband-wife relationship angle from external romance ('pyar kahan chala gaya') to internal domestic numbness ('silent treatment') maintains high viewer retention.
